headline: 13 core protocol contracts catalogued on Base; factory-child enumeration capped per protocol design

findings.text: BaseScan name-tag search found 13 Aerodrome contract addresses matching the protocol; AERO token at 0x940181a94A35A4569E4529A3CDfB74e38FD98631 confirmed across multiple sources
Official deployment table in GitHub README lists all 13 core contracts with Base mainnet addresses and corresponding BaseScan links
Audits identified: Ether Authority security audit (AERO token, June 2024) and MixBytes audit (Pool Launcher)
GitHub repository uses Foundry for deployment; main branch contains verified deployment addresses matching BaseScan
Protocol is Base-only (single chain); all 13 contracts deployed on Base mainnet
PoolFactory, GaugeFactory, VotingRewardsFactory, and ManagedRewardsFactory are factory contracts; child enumeration capped—protocol design creates pools on-demand without enumeration endpoint

Core contracts classified with roles: token (AERO), factory (PoolFactory, GaugeFactory, VotingRewardsFactory, ManagedRewardsFactory), governance (Voter, VotingEscrow), minter, router, and reward distribution contracts
All 13 admin_addresses entries trace to GitHub README deployment table fetched in this run

rationale.verdict: Discovered 13 core Aerodrome V1 contracts on Base via GitHub README (primary source), confirmed via BaseScan and security audit pages. Factory contracts exist (PoolFactory, GaugeFactory, VotingRewardsFactory, ManagedRewardsFactory) but child enumeration is not enumerated in this slice per D6 capping rules—next slice can query factories via read API if needed.

evidence.shows: GitHub repository README contains official deployment table with 13 Base mainnet contract addresses: ArtProxy, RewardsDistributor, FactoryRegistry, Forwarder, GaugeFactory, ManagedRewardsFactory, Minter, PoolFactory, Router, AERO token, Voter, VotingEscrow, VotingRewardsFactory, and Pool (implementation).
AERO token (Aerodrome ERC20) deployed on Base; source code verified; constructor sets minter and owner to deployer; setMinter function transfers minting rights to Minter contract.
PoolFactory contract on Base; manages pool creation and fee configuration; includes pause/unpause functionality via pauser role and fee management via feeManager role.
Router contract on Base; handles multi-pool swaps and liquidity provision similar to Uniswap V2 Router interface; references FactoryRegistry.
FactoryRegistry contract on Base; maintains registry of approved pool, gauge, bribe, and managed reward factories; uses onlyOwner access control.
GaugeFactory contract on Base; creates Gauge contracts for pools; referenced by Voter for gauge creation; includes killGauge and reviveGauge functions with emergency council gating.
Emergency Council address: 0x99249b10593fCa1Ae9DAE6D4819F1A6dae5C013D; Council can be invoked for emergency situations or via governance proposal; audit by MixBytes for Pool Launcher mentioned.

unknowns: D2: No canonical deployed_contracts_doc page located (GitHub README serves as de facto source)
D6: PoolFactory and GaugeFactory child contracts not enumerated—on-demand creation design prevents exhaustive listing; downstreamslices can query via factoryRegistry or factory read methods
D8: Emergency Council address (0x99249b10593fCa1Ae9DAE6D4819F1A6dae5C013D) from security page fetch (non-fetch attempt) - needs on-chain verification in next slice

protocol_metadata.about: Aerodrome is a decentralized exchange (DEX) and liquidity marketplace on the Base network. It enables users to swap tokens and provide liquidity through an AMM model inspired by Solidly, featuring veAERO governance through voting escrow NFTs, gauge-based emission distribution, and a fee-sharing model where protocol revenue flows directly to veAERO token holders.
